readout_other: Brain CT and MMSE for safety; Fugl-Meyer, WMFT, MRC, NIHSS, Barthel, mRS; TMS MEP amplitude and resting motor threshold; fNIRS laterality index
direction_notes: Bilateral trends toward increased MEP amplitude and fNIRS laterality index over 3 months, none statistically significant; motor scores (FMA, WMFT) improved in this single-arm study without sham.
safety_notes: No severe adverse events; minor transient symptoms (scalp tingling, numbness, deep shooting sensation) in 5 of 10 patients; no new haemorrhage or lesions on post-treatment brain CT; MMSE stable.
